sql: SELECT "Institution"."Institution_id" AS k, "Institution"."Enrollment" AS m1 FROM "Institution" WHERE "Institution"."Enrollment" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank Institution rows by number of enrolled students
